title: Video | Axis Bank CEO Amitabh Chaudhary On FCNR(B) Funds, NIM Outlook, ECL Impact And Axis Max Life Stake
text:
Axis Bank MD & CEO Amitabh Chaudhary speaks to NDTV Profit on the bank’s FCNR(B) fund-raising, deployment of funds, NIM outlook and expected impact of the ECL framework. He also discusses Axis Bank’s expansion in Uttar Pradesh and the possibility of increasing its stake in Axis Max Life to 30%. March 18, 2025 13:47
